{{Quote|It was from Kuat Systems. They manufactured the entire Delta line, including the Delta-Seven Aethersprite the Jedi used as starfighters during the early days of the Clone Wars. None of the Deltas had an internal hyperdrive, but TransGalMeg Industries made a hyperdrive ring for it to dock into. The Twelve was basically a larger, two-person version of the Seven that had its weapons stripped off for the civilian market.|[[Dean Jinzler]], to [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="SQ" />}}
The '''Delta-series fighter''',<ref name="FAD" /> also known as the '''Delta line''', was a line of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] manufactured by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]].<ref name="SQ" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Delta date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]. Chapter 23 states that the [[Delta-series fighter/Legends|Delta line]] was sold "around forty years ago" before the events of the novel, placing the sale around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> Kuat Systems Engineering sold the entire Delta line to [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="SQ" />
